skill_name: Write a review of Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill.
workflow: The Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill is an easy-to-use appliance that's perfect for those who want to up their grilling game. With two stainless steel burners and two side tables, you can easily cook for a crowd. The lid-closed dimensions are 44.5"H x 48"W x 27"D and the lid-open measurements are 57"H x 48"W x 26"D, so you really get the best of both worlds with this grill. It heats up quickly, and is great for grilling and smoking food. Highly recommended!
